scope: Two closed draped curtain meshes only; accepted material, plaid texture, location convention and UV repeat preserved.
visual_basis: Reference has curved asymmetric edges and soft nonuniform folds; current render reads as straight extruded rectangular strips.
limitations: Static cloth approximation, not a cloth simulation or exact reconstruction.
These checks establish mesh integrity, not final appearance. Blender/OpenGL comparison required after integration.
The two sides of each curtain are offset by half thickness; envelope can extend by at most 0.8 mm beyond the middle surface.

topology.construction: Two offset surfaces, shared closed rim; no modifiers or simulation.
topology.uv_policy: Fixed material coordinates per grid vertex; matching front/back, flat rim.

integration_source_review.scope: Read-only source review; no Blender execution and no claim about final exported geometry.
integration_source_review.receiver_reason: Both are MESH objects with cloth material; excluded from the ivory/right-wall soft receiver subset.
integration_source_review.runtime_export: Export uses evaluated triangle loops, corner normals and per-loop UVs. No geometry deformation applies to kind 2.
integration_source_review.uv_rim_note: Rim UVs collapse across the 1.6 mm thickness intentionally. Kind 2 uses only plaid albedo and does not require tangent-space normal maps.

cost.basis: Two old 32x8 single-sided grids versus two new 32x16 closed shells; DREAMM02 has 40 bytes per exported vertex.

blender_draft_visual_review.scope: Curtain shape, plaid continuity and gross visual defects only; no judgment on lighting, palette or other objects.
observed_improvements: The inner edge has a mild curve instead of a rigid straight rectangular silhouette.
Pleat depth varies along the drop and gives a more cloth-like shape.
Plaid bands remain visually continuous across the folds; no obvious UV jumps or extra texture mirroring are visible.
remaining_differences: Reference drape and lateral lean are more pronounced than this restrained shape.
The 360x640 draft limits assessment of the 1.6 mm rim and fine fold shading.
not_observed_in_draft: Obvious holes, detached strips or gross self-intersections.
blender_draft_visual_review.pending: Inspect the final Blender/OpenGL exports at delivery resolution before claiming final renderer parity.

renderer_geometry_parity.scope: Geometric export parity and visual continuity of the plaid in three real OpenGL views. This does not assert pixel-perfect appearance, lighting parity or exact reference fidelity.
renderer_geometry_parity.visual_result: Both closed curtains preserve their drape and plaid across the front, radiator-side and right-side views. No obvious missing faces, UV jumps, inverted shading, detached strips or gross intersections are visible in those views.
renderer_geometry_parity.remaining_reference_difference: Reference has stronger lateral lean and a more relaxed drape; no exact cloth reconstruction is claimed.

final_blender_review.scope: Curtain shape and UV continuity only, against OpenGL views and earlier Blender draft D.
final_blender_review.result: Final Blender retains the curved inner edge, variable folds and continuous plaid observed in OpenGL. No obvious holes, texture jumps, detached strips or gross intersections are visible.
final_blender_review.limitation: Visual geometry agreement, not a pixel-perfect appearance match. Reference drape remains more pronounced.
